cross_repeat_folds: select on repeats 1+2; evaluate on repeat 0
select on repeats 0+2; evaluate on repeat 1
select on repeats 0+1; evaluate on repeat 2
replicable_oracle: per task, select the highest mean-utility model on the two selection repeats and score it on the held-out repeat
cross_repeat_best_single: select one global model by mean utility across all tasks on the two selection repeats and score it on the held-out repeat
observed_oracle: per task, select and score the best model on the same held-out repeat
stable_gap: replicable oracle minus cross-repeat best single
winner_ties: deterministic model order; exact ties additionally reported
snr: aggregate top1-top2 mean-utility margin divided by sqrt(sample variance top1 + sample variance top2 + 1e-6)
bootstrap_unit: task with all model/repeat outcomes kept paired
branch_if_stable_gap_ge_threshold: pre-routing observables are insufficient; develop response-aware accept-vs-escalate cascade on development data only
branch_if_stable_gap_lt_threshold: treat apparent routability as substantially noise-inflated; repair measurement before new routing work
specialist_pool_audit: training-only cross-repeat stable complementarity of the anchor plus every one- and two-specialist subset
